title: Arcade Button
summary: A round illuminated button with a bezel.
description: A round illuminated button with a bezel.
accessibility_notes: Saturated glow on black is hard to read: keep body copy near-white and unglowing, and reserve neon for accents.

<!DOCTYPE html>

  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
    body { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #0b0d12; color: #e7ebf3;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
    .fx { width: 96px; height: 96px; border-radius: 50%; border: 6px solid #1a1f2b; cursor: pointer;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 38% 32%, #ffd6ea, #ff2d95 55%, #9d174d);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 0 #4a0d29, 0 0 30px rgba(255,45,149,.6); transition: transform .08s, box-shadow .08s; }
    .fx:active { transform: translateY(6px); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #4a0d29, 0 0 20px rgba(255,45,149,.5); }
